card.name: Syringe and needle equipment descriptions
card.fires_on: The word 'a' or 'an' (or a following adjective) right after 'using' or 'with' when the next words will name a syringe, needle or spike in preparation steps. Also fires on a space before a gauge or size number.

modes.label: Article before syringe or needle
modes.description: The article after 'using' or 'with' in withdrawal instructions, just before a syringe or needle type.
modes.example: Withdraw this amount from the vial using<< a>> sterile needle and sy

modes.label: Size or adjective before equipment
modes.description: A space or adjective that comes before a needle gauge, syringe size or spike type.
modes.example: use a sterile 10 mL syringe and an<< >>18-gauge needle to withdraw

modes.label: Other compound-noun openings
modes.description: Rarely, the start of a compound noun such as sharps container or first class mail.
modes.example: Discard the fondaparinux sodium injection prefilled syringe into a<< shar>>ps container.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, but it leans toward a word that continues a compound or technical noun phrase.
card.plain: It marks the spot in drawing-up instructions where the text is about to name the syringe or needle to use.
